name: What is an ADU and what are its benefits?

mainEntity.name: What is an ADU and what are its benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a secondary housing unit on a single-family residential lot. It can be attached or detached from the main house. Benefits include increased property value, potential rental income, flexible space for family members or a home office, and efficient use of existing land. ADUs can provide additional housing options in densely populated areas like Los Angeles.
acceptedAnswer.description: An ADU is a secondary housing unit on your property, offering benefits like increased value, rental income, and flexible space.
